d: 5 hazar karshapan ke lie balak chandragupt jab aachary ajay ke pas jata hai to vah chandragupt se puchhte hain ki mujhe us vyakti se milna hai jisne tumhen ye pustak di hai. chandragupt pahle to apne aachary ka pata nahin batata magar zor dene par vah bata deta hai. phir ek aisa sach samne aata hai jise dekh kar aapki aankhen nam ho jaengi - kaun hai aachary ajay aur kaun hai kartike? dekhie is bhag men.
